Research Depth

about.p1: A decade of scientific research trained me to tackle ambiguous problems, think in first principles, and validate rigorously — skills that translate directly into building reliable AI systems. Now I apply that mindset to production ML: LLM applications, RAG pipelines, computer vision, and cloud deployments.
about.p2: At Wasimil I was the sole AI engineer — owning the full stack from architecture through deployment for 150+ hotel clients. That experience of building independently under real constraints is something no course can replicate.
